title: Upgrade release manifest
description: The single MACHINE source of truth for upgrade intent (D002): NOT the prose CHANGELOG, NOT the plan ledger. Declares a baseline (CHANGELOG sections at/before which are intentionally not manifest-seeded, D018) plus an ordered releases[] list. Each release declares required/advisory operator actions carrying enough to tell the user WHY, WHETHER IT APPLIES, and WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (D004, D013). Schema is CLOSED: unknown enum values and unknown keys are rejected fail-closed. Cross-field invariants (required-action D021/D029/D036/D047, id-uniqueness D030) are enforced by the loader/Pydantic model, not expressible in plain JSON Schema.

baseline_release.description: Stable id of the baseline release (D018). CHANGELOG sections at/before this baseline are intentionally NOT manifest-seeded; the F009 coverage lint only flags operator-visible sections AFTER the baseline.

baseline_date.description: Baseline date (YYYY-MM-DD). The loader additionally rejects non-calendar dates.

releases.description: Ordered list of releases (oldest -> newest by authoring convention).

date.description: Release date (YYYY-MM-DD). The loader additionally rejects non-calendar dates.

plan_refs.description: Plan ids this release rolls up. Optional; defaults to empty.

summary.description: Human summary of the release (mirrored by / linked from the prose CHANGELOG).

show_on_first_run.description: First-run policy (F004): if true, this release's advisories are shown on a fresh marker; otherwise advisories are suppressed on first run to avoid a flood as the manifest grows.

actions.description: Operator actions for this release (may be empty).

id.description: Action id (unique within its release, D030). Combined with the release id as upgrade:<release>:<action>.

kind.description: Closed enum. required actions are gated by a live status_probe and an ordered preview->apply->verify checklist; advisory actions are informational.

detail.description: The WHY: why this action exists / what it addresses.

commands.description: ORDERED list of exact copyable commands (D017). Empty/omitted for advisories. A required action must include at least an apply-labeled AND a verify-labeled command, in label order (D029/D036).

introduced_commands.description: Optional: new CLI surfaces this release adds.

applies_when.description: Optional predicate key gating applicability. null = always applies. applies_when fails OPEN (unknown -> show it).

status_probe.description: Optional predicate key. null = advisory / no probe. SOLE authority for required-action satisfaction (D004). A required action MUST name a non-null, non-empty probe (D021). status_probe fails CLOSED (unknown -> pending).

failure_message.description: Optional: what an unsatisfied probe means.

label.description: Closed label enum establishing checklist order: preview -> apply -> verify (run = generic single step).

command.description: Exact copyable command string. The loader rejects blank/whitespace-only strings (D047).

description.description: Optional human description of the command step.
